name: ponytail
title_zh: 先问这功能要不要存在，再写最短那版代码
tagline_zh: 你刚说「加个缓存层」，它先反问这需求能不能砍掉；能砍就砍，砍不掉才去标准库和平台原生里找现成的，最后才轮到手写。
tagline_en: Say "add a cache layer" and it first asks whether that requirement can be cut. If it can't, it reaches for the.
desc_en: Forces the laziest solution that actually works, simplest, shortest, most minimal. Channels a senior dev who has seen everything: question whether the task needs to exist at all (YAGNI), reach for the standard library before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra. Use on ANY coding task: writing, addi
why_zh: 它把「少写」当成硬约束而不是风格偏好：先 YAGNI 砍需求，再标准库，再原生能力。
why_en: It treats writing less as a hard constraint, not a style preference: YAGNI the requirement, then stdlib, then native features.
limit_zh: 它只负责砍和简化，不负责替你判断业务优先级——需求真不能砍时它也会照写。默认 full 档对原型和一次性脚本偏啰嗦。
limit_en: It only cuts and simplifies; it won't judge your business priorities, and writes it anyway when the requirement is real. Default full is wordy for.
title_en: Asks if the feature should exist, then writes the shortest.
